cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Only group cash was disclosed; most cash is inside PRC operating subsidiaries or financial company deposits and parent company cash was only RMB59.1m.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash left after excluding disclosed restricted monetary funds.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Large PRC bank wealth-management/FVTPL balance; liquid in practice but product risk, fair value exposure and subsidiary-level extraction uncertainty require a mid haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financial assets held for trading disclosed as wealth management products.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Forward contracts are hedging/mark-to-market positions, not a clean detachable cash pool.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included only at a low value because the asset is financial but operating hedge-linked.

cash_breakdown.item: Time deposits due within one year
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Within-one-year deposits are likely withdrawable or pledgeable, but PRC subsidiary and operating liquidity frictions remain.
cash_breakdown.reason: Presented as non-current assets due within one year, not cash equivalents.

cash_breakdown.item: Other current assets: time deposits and interest
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Short-term deposit/interest balance with similar PRC subsidiary extraction constraints.
Longer tenor deposits are less immediately detachable and may be held by operating subsidiaries.
cash_breakdown.reason: Presented under other non-current assets and explicitly not cash equivalents.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Deposits for issuing bank acceptance notes and other security deposits cannot be stripped without replacing operating credit support.
cash_breakdown.reason: Explicitly disclosed as restricted cash at bank and on hand.

cash_breakdown.item: Interest-bearing bank borrowings and derivative liabilities
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Bank borrowings and current long-term debt are deducted at 100%; derivative financial liabilities are also deducted as financing/hedging obligations.
cash_breakdown.reason: Short-term borrowings, current portion of long-term borrowings, long-term borrowings and transactional financial liabilities.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The group had RMB76.3bn operating cash outflows in 2024; a RMB3.0bn reserve is less than half a month of operating outflows and is conservative versus revenue scale.
cash_breakdown.reason: Retained for purchases, payroll, tax, warranty and seasonal working-capital volatility.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX, dividend and minority-interest friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Parent access to consolidated cash is constrained by PRC subsidiaries, minority interests and distribution/FX friction.

profit_quality.assessment: Main denominator uses 2023 deducted-non-recurring parent net profit of RMB2.355bn as the three-year median of 2022-2024; this is then haircut to 75%. Operating cash flow was positive in all three years, but 2024 OCF fell sharply to RMB5.132bn while inventories, receivables and acceptance-note financing remain large.
adjustments: Use deducted-non-recurring parent net profit rather than reported 2024 parent net profit because 2024 included RMB742.0m non-recurring gains attributable to parent holders.
Use three-year median deducted-non-recurring parent profit: 2022 RMB0.906bn, 2023 RMB2.355bn, 2024 RMB2.606bn.
Apply a 0.75 cash-profit haircut for appliance manufacturing cyclicality, working-capital intensity, large receivables/inventory balances and reliance on wealth-management/time-deposit income.
Do not deduct full lease liabilities from detachable cash; lease burden is treated as part of continuing operations and profit/cash conversion haircut.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB4.032bn in 2022, RMB10.612bn in 2023 and RMB5.132bn in 2024; 2024 capex was RMB1.394bn and 2023 capex was RMB0.985bn.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Profits convert to cash over a cycle, but 2024 OCF deterioration, manufacturing working capital and substantial non-operating financial income prevent using a near-1.0 factor.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year median OCF / median deducted-non-recurring parent profit is about 2.18x, but single-year 2024 OCF / 2024 deducted profit is about 1.97x and fell 51.6% YoY.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Actual capex was RMB1.394bn in 2024 and RMB0.985bn in 2023; maintenance capex is estimated at RMB1.2bn because exact maintenance/growth split is not disclosed.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables, receivable financing and inventories all increased in 2024; OCF still positive but working capital is a live reinvestment requirement.
